tickets.subject: Two-factor codes arriving several minutes late
tickets.description: Customers are receiving SMS two-factor authentication codes three to six minutes after requesting them, by which time the codes have already expired. Voice-call codes arrive immediately, which suggests the issue is isolated to the SMS delivery path. This prevents affected customers from completing sign-in without trying another verification method.

tickets.subject: SSO login loop for the whole finance team
tickets.description: The entire Finance team is unable to sign in because the identity provider sends users back to the login page in a continuous loop. The problem affects eleven people and blocks access to finance tools and records. Initial investigation should focus on the single sign-on redirect and session configuration.

tickets.subject: Checkout returns 500 on card payment
tickets.description: Pro-plan customers receive a server error when they attempt to pay by card at checkout. The issue began after this morning's deployment and has already resulted in three refund requests. The payment flow should be treated as urgent because it prevents new purchases and upgrades.

tickets.subject: Password reset link expires too quickly
tickets.description: Password-reset links currently expire after five minutes, which is too short for customers who must switch to another device or wait for email delivery. Customers can begin the reset process successfully but are unable to finish it before the link expires. Extending the validity period would reduce repeat reset requests.

tickets.subject: Reports page times out for large accounts
tickets.description: The reports page returns a gateway timeout for accounts with more than 50,000 records, while smaller accounts load in under one second. This points to a scale-related query or processing issue rather than a general availability problem. Large customers cannot access the reporting information they need.

tickets.subject: Export to CSV drops the last row
tickets.description: CSV exports containing more than 500 records consistently omit the final row. The problem was reproduced in staging with a 501-row export, confirming that the issue occurs at the record limit boundary. This creates a risk of incomplete customer data being used outside the application.

tickets.subject: Search returns no results for hyphenated names
tickets.description: Searches for hyphenated names such as 'Ade-Kunle' return no results, while the same name without a hyphen works correctly. The issue affects approximately four percent of customer records and makes some contacts difficult to find. Search normalisation should be reviewed so punctuation does not change matching behaviour.

notes.author: Ada Nwosu
notes.body: Workaround sent to the customer while we fix it properly.

tickets.subject: Dashboard chart is empty on first load
tickets.description: The dashboard revenue chart appears blank on its first load even though the underlying data is available. Changing the date range causes the chart to render, but refreshing the page does not resolve the problem. This suggests that the initial chart render is not receiving or reacting to its default data correctly.

tickets.subject: Webhook deliveries silently dropped since 06:00
tickets.description: Partner integrations are reporting that they receive no webhook events, while the internal dashboard records the deliveries as successful. The discrepancy indicates that the failure may occur after the application sends the event. This can leave partners with stale data and no reliable indication that a delivery failed.

tickets.subject: Bulk import rejects valid postcodes
tickets.description: Bulk imports reject otherwise valid postcodes whenever the postcode contains a space. The same records import successfully after the space is removed, which points to overly strict validation. Customers must manually edit legitimate address data before importing it.

tickets.subject: Timezone wrong on scheduled reports
tickets.description: Reports scheduled for 09:00 are delivered at 10:00 for customers in Lagos. The one-hour difference suggests that the scheduler may be using UTC instead of the customer's configured timezone. This affects the reliability of scheduled reporting for users in that region.

tickets.subject: Duplicate confirmation emails on signup
tickets.description: New users on the self-service signup path receive the welcome email twice, usually about thirty seconds apart. The duplicate message does not occur on other signup paths, which narrows the likely source of the problem. Repeated emails can confuse customers and increase unnecessary mail volume.

tickets.subject: API rate limit headers missing
tickets.description: The API documentation promises an X-RateLimit-Remaining response header, but current API responses do not include it. Without this information, API clients cannot accurately slow down before reaching their limit. The implementation and documentation need to be brought back into agreement.

tickets.subject: Cannot remove a user from a workspace
tickets.description: Workspace administrators cannot remove users who were invited but never completed sign-in because the Remove button is disabled. These pending users remain visible even when they should no longer have access. The permission and invitation-state logic for the removal action should be checked.

notes.author: Ada Nwosu
notes.body: Workaround sent to the customer while we fix it properly.

tickets.subject: Add a dark theme to the dashboard
tickets.description: Several customers, especially overnight support teams, have requested a dark theme for the dashboard. The current bright interface can be uncomfortable during extended evening use. A dark theme would be an accessibility and usability improvement rather than an incident fix.

tickets.subject: Attachments over 10MB fail without a message
tickets.description: Uploads larger than 10 MB leave the interface on a loading spinner indefinitely. No error message is shown to the user and no useful error appears in the browser console. Customers do not know that the upload has failed or what they need to do next.

tickets.subject: Saved filters disappear after logging out
tickets.description: Saved filters are stored in the browser session instead of the customer's account. As a result, filters disappear after sign-out and are not available when the user returns. Preferences should be persisted against the account so they work across sessions and devices.

tickets.subject: Slack integration posts to the wrong channel
tickets.description: After a Slack channel is renamed, integration notifications continue to post to the previous channel ID. This means the saved integration target is not updated or revalidated after the rename. Teams can miss important notifications because messages appear in the wrong place.

tickets.subject: Invoice PDF shows the wrong VAT total
tickets.description: Invoice line items display correctly, but the final VAT total is calculated before a discount is applied. The resulting total is therefore incorrect even though the individual amounts look valid. This affects billing accuracy and should be corrected before more invoices are generated.

tickets.subject: Mobile app crashes when opening notifications
tickets.description: The Android mobile app crashes when users open notifications created before the data migration. Crash logs point to a missing notification title, while newer notifications work normally. The notification screen needs to handle older records that do not contain every current field.

tickets.subject: Allow custom fields on the contact record
tickets.description: Customers need an internal account code field on each contact record, but the product currently has no structured place to store it. Teams are placing this information in the notes field, making it difficult to search and maintain. A custom-field capability would provide a more reliable solution.

tickets.subject: Search index stale after bulk import
tickets.description: Records imported in bulk were not searchable until the nightly reindex completed. The system now reindexes each batch, but the ticket documents the previous delay and the fix. Faster indexing is important so imported records are available immediately after a successful upload.

notes.author: Tunde Bello
notes.body: Root cause found -- fix in review.

tickets.subject: Export the audit log to CSV
tickets.description: Compliance teams need to export the audit log every quarter, but the current process requires copying information manually from the interface. This is slow, error-prone, and difficult to repeat consistently. A CSV export would make the process auditable and much more efficient.

tickets.subject: Password reset email is slow
tickets.description: Password-reset emails were taking around twenty minutes to arrive because the outbound mail queue was backed up. Delayed delivery prevented customers from quickly regaining access to their accounts. The issue has been traced to the queue, but delivery performance should continue to be monitored.

notes.author: Ife Adeyemi
notes.body: Workaround sent to the customer while we fix it properly.

tickets.subject: Keyboard shortcuts for the ticket list
tickets.description: The support team has requested keyboard shortcuts, such as j and k, to move through tickets in the queue. Their previous tool supported this interaction and the team relies on it for faster keyboard-based work. Adding shortcuts would improve navigation efficiency for frequent users.

tickets.subject: Onboarding checklist never marks itself complete
tickets.description: The final step in the onboarding checklist remains unchecked even after the required action has been completed. This makes new accounts appear stalled in reporting and can prompt unnecessary follow-up. The completion event is likely not being saved or reflected in the checklist state.

tickets.subject: Customers cannot update their billing address
tickets.description: The Save button on the billing-address form appeared to do nothing because a validation rule silently rejected valid input. Customers were unable to update their billing information and received no explanation. Validation failures should be surfaced clearly so users can correct the form.

tickets.subject: Bulk edit tags on contacts
tickets.description: Teams must currently retag contacts one at a time after a campaign, turning a routine task into an afternoon of manual work. There is no way to select a set of contacts and apply tags in bulk. Bulk editing would reduce repetitive work and lower the chance of inconsistent tagging.

notes.author: Ada Nwosu
notes.body: Workaround sent to the customer while we fix it properly.

tickets.subject: Customer data export contained another account's rows
tickets.description: A missing filter in the customer-data export query caused one account's export to include rows belonging to another account. The incident was contained, the affected customer was notified, and a post-mortem has been scheduled. This is a serious data-isolation issue that requires prevention measures and verification.

notes.author: Ife Adeyemi
notes.body: Workaround sent to the customer while we fix it properly.

tickets.subject: Show the last login date on the user list
tickets.description: Support teams need the last login date on the user list to identify dormant accounts before the annual licence review. The information exists elsewhere but is not visible where the review takes place. Showing it in the list would make account-cleanup decisions faster and more reliable.

tickets.subject: API returning 401 for valid keys
tickets.description: API keys created within the previous hour were rejected with 401 responses even though they were valid. A caching layer was holding an outdated list of keys and did not recognise newly created ones. This prevented integrations from being configured immediately after key creation.

tickets.subject: Sandbox environment for integration testing
tickets.description: Integration partners want a dedicated sandbox environment where they can test safely without affecting production data. At the moment they test against the live system and the team must clean up the resulting records. A sandbox would reduce operational risk and make partner testing more practical.

tickets.subject: Weekly digest sent twice
tickets.description: The weekly digest email was sent twice because the scheduled job ran on both application servers. A lock now guards the job, but the ticket records the duplicate-send incident. Job coordination should be monitored to ensure only one server performs each scheduled run.

notes.author: Ada Nwosu
notes.body: Asked the customer for a screenshot.

tickets.subject: Contact import fails on accented characters
tickets.description: Contact names containing accented characters were imported as question marks because files were read as ASCII instead of UTF-8. This corrupted customer names during import and reduced data quality. The importer must consistently detect or require UTF-8 encoding.

notes.author: Tunde Bello
notes.body: Asked the customer for a screenshot.

notes.author: Tunde Bello
notes.body: Looks like a regression from the Friday deploy.

tickets.subject: Login page missing the company logo
tickets.description: The company logo disappeared from the login page after a CDN configuration change. The rest of the page remained available, but the missing logo made the sign-in experience appear incomplete and less trustworthy. The affected asset path and CDN cache configuration should be reviewed.

notes.author: Ada Nwosu
notes.body: Workaround sent to the customer while we fix it properly.

notes.author: Ada Nwosu
notes.body: Root cause found -- fix in review.

tickets.subject: Payment retries charged customers twice
tickets.description: The payment retry job charged some customers twice because it did not verify that an earlier attempt had already succeeded. Fourteen duplicate charges were identified and refunded. Retry processing needs an idempotency check so a successful payment can never be charged again.

notes.author: Ada Nwosu
notes.body: Workaround sent to the customer while we fix it properly.

notes.author: Ada Nwosu
notes.body: Root cause found -- fix in review.

tickets.subject: Mobile layout broken on the settings page
tickets.description: The settings form overflowed horizontally on phones narrower than 380 pixels. Users had to scroll sideways to access parts of the form, making configuration difficult on smaller devices. The responsive layout needs to constrain fields and controls within the viewport.

notes.author: Grace Mensah
notes.body: Looks like a regression from the Friday deploy.

tickets.subject: Status page did not update during the outage
tickets.description: During Tuesday's outage, the public status page remained green for forty minutes instead of reflecting the incident. Customers had no timely indication that the service was experiencing a problem. The incident-to-status-page update process needs better automation or escalation.

notes.author: Tunde Bello
notes.body: Root cause found -- fix in review.

tickets.subject: Support inbox rules stopped applying
tickets.description: Incoming support email bypassed routing rules for two days and landed in the general queue instead of the appropriate teams. This delayed handling and made ownership unclear for affected conversations. The inbox-rule processing path should be investigated and monitored for future failures.

tickets.subject: Trial accounts not expiring
tickets.description: Trial accounts created before the pricing change did not expire as expected, leaving sixty accounts with indefinite free access. The issue is linked to legacy trial rules that were not updated during the pricing change. Expiry logic should be corrected and existing affected accounts reviewed.
